'''Virgillia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="Truce">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
